selection: Evaluate every arm frozen by pilot validation selection; neither the built-in8-case test nor confirmation outcomes select the checkpoint or tune parameters.
baseline: Original four-thermal balanced contractor; samephysics, five drones, weather and constraints.
comparison: Identical100 scenarios shared across all3 arms; each policy matched to its own contractor replay with trajectory/constraint hashes checked.
statistics: Mean paired warning and detection deltas, sample SD, standard error, approximate95%CI = mean +/-1.96SE; descriptive per frozen policy, not independence across all300 arm-case values.
authorization: Root requested all100 confirmation cases for all3 arms before any pilot outcome; execute only after all pilot arms finish.
retention: Keep all regressions and all per-case arrays, source context, selected/final weights; raw frames remain Saved.
